title: RNA Extraction from Cultured Human Dorsal Root Ganglia
author: Joesph B Lesnak
materials: Cell cultures are prepared as described in dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kxygxyd64l8j/v1
Keep collection tube, and discard column

steps.title: Prepare RLT Plus Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare RLT Plus lysis buffer containing Beta mercaptoethanol in a separate tube within a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add Beta mercaptoethanol to RLT Plus Buffer at a 1:100 ratio (e.g., 10 ul of Beta mercaptoethanol to 1 ml of RLT Plus).
Vortex the mixture.
Prepare 350 ul of this buffer for each sample.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 70% and 80% ethanol solutions by diluting 100% ETOH in Ultrapure Distilled Water.

steps.title: Wash and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cultured human dorsal root ganglia and lyse them using the prepared RLT Plus buffer.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media and wash cells once with 500 ul of 1X DPBS.
Working one well at a time, aspirate the DPBS and add 350 ul of RLT plus buffer with Beta mercaptoethanol to each well (pipette carefully to avoid bubbles).
Scrape down cells using a cell scraper, collect the RLT plus buffer, and place in a 1.5 ml tube.
Vortex all samples for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Remove Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Eliminate gDNA using a gDNA eliminator spin column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a gDNA eliminator spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds at ≥8000g at room temperature.
Add 1 volume of 70% ETOH (typically around 350 ul) to the flow-through and mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Bind RNA to RNeasy Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to an RNeasy MinElute spin column and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to an RNeasy MinElute spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000g at room temperature.
Add 350 ul of RW1 to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform On-Column DNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Treat the bound RNA with DNase to remove contaminating DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the DNase by adding 70 ul of RDD buffer to 10 ul aliquots of reconstituted DNase.
Add 80 ul of the RDD buffer + DNase mixture directly to the spin column.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Add 350 ul of RW1 to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash RNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the RNeasy MinElute spin column to remove impurities.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 ul of RPE to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds at ≥8000g at room temperature.
Add 500 ul of 80% ETOH to the RNeasy MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at ≥8000g at room temperature.

steps.title: Dry the Column
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol from the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place the MinElute spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube.
Open the lid of the spin column.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at full speed (16,000g) at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA and store it at ultra-low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Place the MinElute spin column in a new 1.5 ml collection tube.
Place 14 ul of DNA/RNA free water directly to the center of the spin column.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at full speed (16,000g).
Freeze and store RNA in a -80°C freezer.
